title: Create unit tests for AdminAkshareController
description: Create comprehensive unit test suite for AdminAkshareController covering all admin endpoints for akshare gateway operations
approach: Follow existing controller/service test patterns using Jest mocks for HttpService, EnvService, and PrismaService dependencies. Test all 3 endpoints: version, status, upgrade with various scenarios including error handling and disabled states

tasks.title: Create admin-akshare.controller.spec.ts with test setup
tasks.description: Create the test file with proper imports, mock setup for all dependencies (HttpService, EnvService, PrismaService), and controller instantiation
implementation: Create new file admin-akshare.controller.spec.ts in apps/api/src/modules/akshare/
Import AdminAkshareController and required types
Create mock HttpService with get/post methods returning observables
Create mock EnvService with akshareConfig.baseUrl and akshareAdminToken
Create mock PrismaService (for audit log writing)
Instantiate controller with all mocked dependencies
Add beforeEach to reset mocks between tests
acceptance_criteria: File exists at apps/api/src/modules/akshare/admin-akshare.controller.spec.ts
Mock HttpService created with get/post stubs returning rxjs observables
Mock EnvService with akshareConfig and akshareAdminToken getters
Controller instantiated with all mock dependencies
Test file compiles without TypeScript errors

tasks.title: Add tests for version endpoint
tasks.description: Add test cases for GET /admin/akshare/version endpoint
implementation: Add describe block for 'version'
Test case: returns akshareVersion and pythonVersion from gateway response
Test case: returns fallback values ('unknown') when gateway returns 404
Test case: throws HttpException when gateway returns other errors
Mock http.get to return observable with version response
Use rxjs 'of' to create mock observables, 'throwError' for errors
acceptance_criteria: 3 test cases for version endpoint
Tests verify successful version retrieval
Tests verify 404 fallback behavior
Tests verify error propagation for non-404 errors
All tests pass
